summary: Frontend-only visual/computed-style audit of the flat-solid Pulse brand polish. Logged in as owner@isodemo.com (IsoDemo123!) and swept /dashboard, /crm, /memberships, /service-desk. Verified (a) active shadcn tab pills render flat solid Core Blue rgb(25,205,255) with dark Soft Black-ish text rgb(10,12,16) and NO background-image (no gradient), (b) .gx-grad-text renders solid rgb(0,115,164) deep-cyan with no background-image (no gradient), (c) banned palette scan (navy 37,99,235 / violet 124,58,237 / purple 147,51,234 / indigo 79,70,229 / teal 20,184,166) returns ZERO hits on /dashboard, /crm, /service-desk. ONE violation found on /memberships: the MembershipsConsole sub-tab active pill still has an inline box-shadow with navy rgba(37,99,235,0.35). Pages render, no app-level JS errors, tabs remain clickable, active-tab dark text (rgb 10,12,16) is legible on cyan.

ui_bugs.issue: Active sub-tab pill (e.g. 'Start' on /memberships) still emits banned navy box-shadow 'rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.35) 0px 6px 16px -6px'. Pill visual is flat cyan (tailwind alias flattens the gradient) but the shadow literal rgba(37,99,235,0.35) is still present in the inline style — violates the 'no navy box-shadow' rule.

/dashboard active tab pill (shadcn TabsL.verdict: PASS — flat solid Core Blue, dark legible text, cyan shadow (not navy)

root_cause_of_navy_shadow_on_/membership.snippet: activeStyle = isPulseBrandedMbr ? { background: 'var(--color-brand-cyan)', color: 'var(--color-ink)' } : { backgroundImage: 'linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gx-brand-from) 0%, var(--gx-brand-to) 100%)', color: '#FFFFFF', boxShadow: '0 6px 16px -6px rgba(37,99,235,0.35)' };
root_cause_of_navy_shadow_on_/membership.explanation: On this route/tenant the ternary falls into the ELSE branch, which still applies the legacy inline linear-gradient AND a navy rgba(37,99,235,0.35) box-shadow. Because tailwind now aliases the gradient stops to Core Blue, the background collapses to flat cyan visually — but the inline navy shadow literal is unchanged, so the scan flags it. Same pattern exists at /app/frontend/src/pages/CRM/CRMApp.js line 1019 (didn't trip on /crm today because that branch didn't render, but is latent).

js_errors_observed: Only CSP-blocked third-party analytics scripts (emergent-main.js, posthog, cloudflareinsights) — NOT app code. No React/render errors on any of the 4 tested routes.
action_items: Replace the literal 'rgba(37,99,235,0.35)' box-shadow in the else-branch of MembershipsConsole.js line 260 (and CRMApp.js line 1019) with a cyan shadow using var(--rgb-brand-blue) e.g. boxShadow: '0 6px 16px -6px rgba(25,205,255,0.35)' — or simply drop the else branch and always render the flat Pulse-branded style since the palette is now uniformly Core Blue.

Optional sweep: replace remaining rgba(37,99,235,*) literals across Marketing/*, MasterAdmin/*, PulseLandingPage.js, RevenueAutopilotPanel.js, ContactsTab.js, AxisOrbit.js, TrialFeedback.js, PricingMarketingPage.js, and index.css --rgb-pulse-primary token. These didn't render on today's owner routes but are latent violations.
No fix needed for active-tab dark text — rgb(10,12,16) on rgb(25,205,255) is high-contrast and legible.
critical_code_review_comments: Palette drift: 20+ files still embed literal rgba(37,99,235,*) — the 'no navy' rule should be enforced at the token layer (make --rgb-pulse-primary and --rgb-brand-blue both point to 25 205 255) rather than hunting each hard-coded literal.

Ternary dead-branch smell: activeStyle ternaries in MembershipsConsole.js and CRMApp.js still ship the legacy gradient/navy path. Since Pulse is now the only brand and gradients are banned, delete the else branch to prevent future regressions.
MembershipsConsole.js is 1774 lines — exceeds the 700-line guideline; consider splitting.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — 3 of 4 routes fully compliant; 1 navy box-shadow remains on /memberships sub-tab active pill

rca of the issue: MembershipsConsole active-pill inline-style else-branch (line 260) predates the flat-solid sweep. Its background gradient collapses to flat cyan due to the tailwind alias, but the boxShadow literal 'rgba(37,99,235,0.35)' is unaffected by the alias (it's a raw CSS value, not a tailwind class). Fix: change the literal to cyan or unify branches to the Pulse-branded style.
